title: NFL line-originator cross-desk review
lead: An additive, read-only audit of the NFL line-originator desks at the pinned evidence snapshot. The repository has useful source-linked research structures, but its price, roster and coverage records contain unresolved scope conflicts; this review made no new NFL data capture.
decision: Keep all strategies in PAPER / shadow status. Do not use the disputed operator-price rows for a market residual, CLV or ROI; do not treat the recorded Week 11 injury response as current; leave unverified starter, inactive, snap and joint-outcome values blank and flagged.
freshness_notice: No official or operator webpage was fetched in this review. Findings are pinned to evidence snapshot 2f02e1e7975ee61780b39e1ef9bc83591ccb55e2; commits after that snapshot are outside scope and may change the broader repository. Source URLs are historical references recorded by prior desks, not fresh confirmations.

categories.title: Lines & prices
categories.description: Line schemas exist, but market-price evidence conflicts: the engine stores close-labelled FanDuel rows, while the market desk stores empty operator open/close rows. Resolve provenance before using market comparisons.

categories.title: Results & fixtures
categories.description: Existing verifiers reconcile their own results; counts differ across dated captures, and one Week 11 command-desk origination row is absent.

categories.title: Injuries, starters & depth
categories.description: Week 10 report captures and a single-game Game Book extraction exist. A separate nflverse snap-count aggregate is third-party and covers weeks 1–9 only; neither it nor the Game Book URL inventory establishes current Week 10/11 starters, inactives or snaps.
categories.official_label: Requested NFL Week 11 injury-report endpoint (not re-fetched)

categories.title: Model validation & strategy gates
categories.description: Pre-registration, controls, proper scores, uncertainty and gates are represented in separate desks. The inspected leaderboards show zero certified strategies; this review does not establish wagering readiness.
